# Gesture fixtures

`gesture-static.png` is a synthetic 480 × 480 square on a cream background.
It is test art, not a hand signal or approved product artwork.

The offline suite copies it into a temporary production build to exercise
static gesture previews and touch controls. It is never copied into the
production site's public directory. Animated gesture, responsive layout,
localization and offline playback tests use the real Martelo animation at
`public/hand-signals/martelo-break.webp`.
